mouth.name: Pucker — Smile
mouth.instruction: Push your lips forward into a pucker, hold for 2 seconds, then break into a wide smile. Repeat.
mouth.gesture: Spread your arms on the smile, bring them in to your chest on the pucker.

mouth.name: Tick-Tock
mouth.instruction: Open your mouth slightly and reach with your tongue to the left corner of your lips, then to the right — like a pendulum.
mouth.gesture: Turn your head left and right, following your tongue.

mouth.name: Pony
mouth.instruction: Click your tongue like clopping hooves, speeding up from slow to fast.
mouth.gesture: Flick your wrists lightly to the rhythm of the clopping.

mouth.name: Needle
mouth.instruction: Stick out a narrow, pointed tongue and hold it tense. Relax and repeat.
mouth.gesture: Reach one arm forward together with your tongue.

mouth.name: Spatula
mouth.instruction: Rest a wide, relaxed tongue on your lower lip and keep it flat and still.
mouth.gesture: Keep your open palms resting calmly in front of you.

mouth.name: Seesaw
mouth.instruction: With the tip of your tongue, reach up toward your nose, then down toward your chin, taking turns.
mouth.gesture: Gently rock your body up and down in time.

title: The Power of a Kind Word

mouth.name: Puff — Deflate Cheeks
mouth.instruction: Take a breath, puff out both cheeks, hold for 2 seconds, then slowly let the air out.
mouth.gesture: Open your arms as you breathe in, bring them together as you breathe out.

mouth.name: Brushing Teeth
mouth.instruction: Run the tip of your tongue in a circle along the inside of your teeth — in both directions.
mouth.gesture: Draw circles in the air with your hand in time with your tongue.

mouth.name: Tasty Jam
mouth.instruction: With a wide tongue, lick your upper lip from top to bottom, as if tasting jam.
mouth.gesture: Raise an open palm to your lips, then lower it.

mouth.name: Pendulum
mouth.instruction: Open your mouth and move your lower jaw left and right, smoothly and evenly.
mouth.gesture: Swing your lowered arms like a pendulum.

mouth.name: Picket Fence
mouth.instruction: Close your teeth and stretch your lips wide to show your “picket fence”. Hold, then relax.
mouth.gesture: Spread your arms out to the sides, holding the tension.

mouth.name: Little Drum
mouth.instruction: Tap the tip of your tongue just behind your upper teeth: “d-d-d”, getting faster.
mouth.gesture: Lightly tap your fingers on the table to the rhythm.

mouth.name: Pucker — Smile
mouth.instruction: Push your lips forward into a pucker, hold for 2 seconds, then break into a wide smile. Repeat.
mouth.gesture: Spread your arms on the smile, bring them in to your chest on the pucker.
